title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 40 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 40)

content.overview: Section 40 provides that an arbitration agreement is not discharged by the death of a party and is enforceable by or against the legal representative of the deceased, subject to the Act and applicable law concerning insolvency and representation.

content.study:
Section 40 — Arbitration agreement not discharged by death of party

Section 40 provides that an arbitration agreement is not discharged by the death of a party and is enforceable by or against the legal representative of the deceased, subject to the Act and applicable law concerning insolvency and representation.

The section must be applied by identifying the statutory trigger, connected provisions and procedural consequence. Limitation, insolvency or jurisdictional effects must be determined from the text and applicable statute rather than assumed from general arbitration practice.
